snippet.title: Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence, a medieval medical simulation game developed by PST Games. Players will evolve into a reputable doctor as the plague spreads day by day. Establish a clinic, gather resources, and perform surgeries to save those affected, or watch it all crumble. Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence is coming soon to PC (Steam).
